response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong track record in web, backend, and high-throughput services (notably low-latency microservices at Sociomantic handling millions of requests/second), plus community leadership through workshops and open-source projects. However, the role's core minimum qualification — 8 years of C++ programming — is not met; C/C++ appears only in a ~7-month stint at National Instruments and a university thesis project, and C++ is absent from the listed skills. There is also little evidence of large-scale cloud compute platform architecture, formal technical leadership of engineering teams, or ownership of infrastructure at the scale described. Strong generalist, but a poor match for this specific C++/compute-platform lead role.
strengths: Broad 15+ year full-stack career across web, mobile, embedded, and DevOps
Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems experience at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby
Proven mentoring via workshops, courses, talks, and open-source tooling
concerns: Far short of the 8-year C++ requirement (~7 months of C/C++ work)
No production cloud compute platform architecture or hardware/storage depth
No formal technical leadership role managing priorities across teams

key_factors.factor: Distributed systems and mentoring track record
